theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the confirmed leader by score and rank, and they clear the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true). The validated edge on this market is drawdown avoidance via that trend gate, so keeping exposure to the eligible leader is defensible. However, the theme is crowded (crowding_z 1.02) with mean-revert hurst_tag and is NOT scorable (no ETF proxy), so this is a stay-with-the-leader-on-discipline view, not a momentum chase.

crowded=true, crowding_z=1.02 (size-down caution, not a fade)
theses.dissent: Mean-revert hurst_tag plus crowding suggests the leadership may be late-stage and vulnerable to a sharp shake-out; breadth of 0.769 is decent but not overwhelming, and the theme has no scorable proxy to verify the view.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only other higher-ranked eligible theme, second in score, trend-tagged (hurst_tag=trend) with the highest durability_bar (0.68) among the top ranks and not crowded. It represents the non-bank side of the narrow eligible set, and with rotation margin at 0.168 and absorption only 0.45, the tape is not yet all-in on banks. A lean toward the other eligible trend leg is a modest expression of the two-leg structure.
theses.dissent: The theme is not scorable and breadth is only 0.6, suggesting the trend is concentrated in few names; a market-level corrective in resources could knock it off eligibility quickly.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) falls out of eligible status or scores below Conglomerates & Exchange before the check-by date.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: As the third eligible theme with mixed trend health and a positive score, High-Dividend Blue Chips offers a defensive, income-oriented leg inside the narrow eligible set. It is not crowded and has a slightly better durability_bar (0.64) than Banks. This is a low-conviction preference for staying with whatever clears the gate over the uneligible majority.
theses.dissent: Mixed hurst_tag and middling breadth mean no clear trend persistence; the signal could be no better than a static yield trade and may lag a bank-led tape.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips loses eligible status within 20 trading days.
